meaning: Sends your online traffic through a private link. A good one scrambles it, so people on the same Wi-Fi cannot read it.
clues: It is a tool that helps protect your online activity.
It can help protect you when you use public Wi-Fi.
It usually sends your connection through a private, scrambled path.
It cannot hide you fully or stop every bad website.
Its short name has three letters.
assumes: A firewall filters some network traffic
Antivirus software checks for harmful programs
Private browsing mode does not hide activity from the network

decoys.meaning: A security tool that blocks or allows some network links.
Software that looks for harmful programs and helps remove or block them.
A browser mode that limits saved history on the device you are using.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: A trusted VPN can protect the connection by sending it through a private path. Still use safe websites and strong account security.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A locked route helps, but you still choose where to go. We locked the door before leaving home.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: A VPN cannot stop a fake website from tricking you or make every action private.
